name: Barbell Glute Bridge
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent, feet planted hip-width apart, and a barbell positioned squarely across your hip creases.
Hold the bar steady with both hands, tuck your ribs down, and brace your abs.
Drive through your heels to raise your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes firmly at the top, then lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
tips: Keep your ribs tucked down so you extend through your glutes without arching your lower back.
Use a folded towel beneath the barbell if the bar presses uncomfortably into your hips.
